CFB Schedule 2026

Every FBS game of the 2026 season, from ESPN — kickoffs in Eastern time, TV where it has been announced, scores once games go final, ranks from the AP top 25. Beside each game: the GordStats line and win chance, the DraftKings line, ESPN's FPI win chance and the kickoff forecast. Right now 161 upcoming games carry a book line and 97 a forecast; both fill in as the week approaches. Rebuilt daily (last: Sep 1, 9:17 PM EDT).

What the columns and tags mean
  • GordStats — this site's model: the favourite and spread, its win chance, the projected total and (for games still to play) the projected score. A finished game shows the line that was on record before kickoff, never one refit afterwards, and ✓ or ✗ says whether the pick won.
  • DraftKings — the book's spread, total and moneyline as ESPN carries them, captured before kickoff and frozen there. Games more than a week or so out usually have no line yet.
  • FPI — ESPN's Football Power Index projection: its favourite and that team's win chance, marked ✓ or ✗ once the game is over.
  • Weather — ESPN's AccuWeather forecast for kickoff, which appears about ten days out: conditions, temperature, chance of rain, gusts. Bad weather means rain, storms or snow, a 50%+ chance of rain, gusts of 25+ mph, or a kickoff at or below freezing.
  • Tags — Home dog: the home team is the underdog on the book's line (the model's, if there is no book line yet). Toss-up: the spread is three points or fewer. Upset: the favourite lost. Upset watch in the filters: the model or FPI gives the underdog at least a 35% chance, or the two disagree on who is favoured.
  • Sorting by anything other than kickoff turns the week into one ranked list; games without the figure being sorted on fall to the bottom. Matchup quality is ESPN's 0–100 measure of how competitive and consequential a game projects to be.
